projects.project_name: MEAG: ALCOVY ROAD - SKC 115 KV RECONDUCTOR
uncertainties: The project title designates terminals as Alcovy Road - SKC, while the project description specifies reconductoring 0.53 miles from Alcovy Road to Alcovy Road Jct. on the Alcovy Road - SKC 115kV line.
Document contains CEII and confidentiality notices regarding transmission planning information.

evidence.text: MEAG: ALCOVY ROAD - SKC 115 KV RECONDUCTOR
MEAG will reconductor approximately 0.53 miles of 100C 336 ACSR conductor with 100C 1033 ACSR conductor from Alcovy Road to Alcovy Road Jct. on the Alcovy Road - SKC 115kV line.

projects.project_name: MEAG: AULTMAN ROAD - BONAIRE PRIMARY 115 KV REBUILD
uncertainties: The project title designates the line as Aultman Road - Bonaire Primary, while the description specifies work on the Sleepy Hollow - Peach Blossom 115kV section and replacing jumpers at Sleepy Hollow. GTC is also listed as performing jumper work.
Document contains CEII and confidentiality notices regarding transmission planning information.

evidence.text: MEAG: AULTMAN ROAD - BONAIRE PRIMARY 115 KV REBUILD

MEAG: Rebuild approximately 1.99 miles of Sleepy Hollow - Peach Blossom 115kV section of the Aultman Road - Bonaire Primary 115kV line from 100C 336 ACSR to 100C 795 ACSR. GTC: Replace the jumpers at Sleepy Hollow with 1590 AAC.
